_comment: Every action (combat skill) a unit can use: fight/combat_skill.gd, read by fight/actions/action_table.gd. Bot skills name one through bot_skill_effects in combat_tuning.json; enemies list them in enemy_tables.json. Every number is a first guess, not balance.
_fields_comment: name, energy_cost (whole points), power_percent (damage per hit or hp restored, in percent of attack; for a guard, the share of the next hit blocked). effect: damage (default), heal or guard. target: opponent (default for damage), all_opponents, ally (default for heal and guard; the user included) or self.
_rework_fields_comment: Combat rework fields, all optional, unused by fights until the session named: recovery (gauge pushed back after acting, default 0; S2), hit_count (default 1; S3), damage_type (default untyped ""; S13), tags (labels for the action tagger; S6), applies_status (a statuses.json id; S3), payoff_condition (a statuses.json id the target must hold) with payoff_bonus_percent (S3).
